messages:
laura: Heads-up — we need a decision on what the minimal shipper exposes for sampled request/response logs. Legal flagged PII risk and wants redact-by-default. Any quick takes?
ben: +1 redact-by-default. but we should keep a debug path for oncall.
laura: Exactly — two axes: sampling % and redact strategy. Also need to consider routing/quotas if inspect-mode spikes ingestion.
sanjay: For routing, we can route inspected traces to a separate hot path (no SLO hit) with quota caps per-org. If quota exceeded, fallback to metadata-only samples.
maria: UX question — in console, how do we show customers that a sample was partially redacted? We can surface granularity: full, meta-only, masked-fields.
kevin: Agree. Also we must keep key management rules: any sampled payloads stored must be encrypted with customer KMS when private deployment. Hosted can use RW KMS, but flag in audit logs.
laura: For policy, I'm leaning toward: default sample_rate=0.01, redaction=fieldmask, inspect-mode requires explicit opt-in + breakglass auth, and temporary unmasking needs TTL + audit trail.
ben: Implementation notes: fieldmask is simplest for structured payloads but for free text we need deid heuristics + fast-hash for identifiers. Can we avoid storing raw text at all?
sanjay: We can store original text in ephemeral blob store encrypted & TTL'd for 24h only for breaks. Most infra components will operate on masked copy.
maria: Console flag ideas: "Enable Inspect Mode" -> checkbox + reason prompt + 2FA. Show a count of remaining breakglass minutes.
kevin: There's also routing interplay: route-inspect -> Dedicated capacity only (to avoid noisy shared hosts). That means we should add a routing policy that pins inspect requests to dedicated pools. Ops must confirm capacity.
laura: Quick sample config prototype (for infra & docs):
```json
{
  "sampler": "route-aware",
  "default_sample_rate": 0.01,
  "inspect_routes": ["/v1/debug/*"],
  "redaction": {
    "strategy": "fieldmask",
    "fields": ["user_email","ssn","phone","credit_card"],
    "hash_salt": "env:LOG_SALT"
  },
  "ephemeral_ttl_secs": 86400,
  "inspect_breakglass_ttl_secs": 900
}
```
maria: Love that. For analytics we also need to emit metadata-level telemetry for every request (no PII). That includes route, model, latency, sample_flag.
ben: For hashing sensitive fields, use HMAC-SHA256 with per-tenant salt. But Legal will want deterministic vs non-deterministic hashing discussion — deterministic helps dedupe but increases re-identification risk.
kevin: We should default to non-deterministic (random salt per-sample) for hosted customers, and offer deterministic/tenant-salt option behind an enterprise toggle. Document the tradeoffs.
laura: Audit: every unmask action must create an immutable audit event tied to user + MFA + reason. Ops-bot should emit a deploy message when the feature flag flips.
ops-bot: feature-flag deploy started: feature=inspect_shipper_v1 env=staging user=laura
ben: Perf concerns: sample payload size may blow out metrics ingestion. Need a size cap per-sample (e.g., 64KB) and truncate gracefully.
sanjay: Also cache sampled KV prefixes for repeated prompts (prefill) to reduce cost. Cache must respect redaction boundaries.
maria: Console UX for sampled view: show original redaction mask, allow requestor to "request unmask" which triggers approval flow. Don't auto-unmask.
kevin: Security note: private deploys must enforce KMS-backed encryption + HSM audit logs. Hosted: require customer to opt into storing any raw payloads. Default = no raw storage.
laura: Action items: 1) eng-platform drafts RFC with config shape & routing policy by EOD Friday (ben + sanjay). 2) devex to mock console flows (maria). 3) security & legal to sign off on audit/unmask process (kevin). 4) ops to capacity-check dedicated pools for inspect routing (ops).
ben: I'll open the RFC draft PR and add perf simulations.
sanjay: I'll add a simple prototype for route-aware sampler in the runtime and a toggle to pin to dedicated pools.
maria: I'll put a wireframe in figma and link in the RFC.
kevin: I'll collect legal notes on hashing/determinism and KMS requirements.
laura: If no objections, we'll treat this as our default shipper policy and iterate in the RFC. :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
ops-bot: feature-flag deploy success: feature=inspect_shipper_v1 env=staging
